title: How do snowmen melt?
examples: Teacher, why does the snowman get smaller?
Is the sun the only thing that melts snowmen?

explain.say: When it is very cold, snowmen stay strong and solid.
Warmth means having more heat energy around you.
The sun gives off lots of warmth when it shines brightly.
When ice gets enough warmth, it starts to change its form.
This change from solid ice to liquid water is called melting.
In real life, a snowman melts when it gets warm from the sun.

faq.q: Does the wind melt the snowman?
faq.a: The wind itself does not melt it, but if the wind brings warm air, that warmth causes the melting.
asks: Is wind hot enough to melt snow?

faq.q: Does the snowman melt faster if it is in the shade?
faq.a: No, the snowman will melt faster in the direct sun because the sun provides more warmth energy.
asks: Where does snow melt the slowest?

faq.q: Does the snowman melt if I breathe on it?
faq.a: Yes, your breath is warm, and that small amount of warmth can start to melt the surface a little bit.
asks: Is breath warm enough to melt ice?

faq.q: Does it melt if I put it near a heater?
faq.a: Yes, heaters give off a lot of warmth, which will quickly cause the snow to change into water.
asks: Is a heater bad for snowmen?

faq.q: What is the difference between melting and evaporating?
faq.a: Melting is when ice turns into liquid water. Evaporating is when liquid water turns into invisible water gas.
asks: Is melting the same as boiling?

facts: Snow is frozen water, which is a solid state.
Warmth is a form of energy that causes changes.
Melting is the change from a solid state to a liquid state.
The sun provides a major source of warmth on Earth.

quiz.say: What causes the snowman to get smaller?
quiz.why: Warmth provides the energy needed for the ice to change.

wrong.0: Wind speed is only one factor, but the warmth is the main cause of melting.
wrong.1: Gravity just pulls it down, it does not change the state of the ice.
wrong.2: The color of the snowman does not affect how it melts.

quiz.say: When ice changes to water, what process is happening?
quiz.why: Melting is the scientific name for ice turning into liquid water.

wrong.0: Freezing is the opposite process; it turns water into ice.
wrong.1: Evaporation is when liquid water turns into gas, not when ice melts.
wrong.2: Condensation is when water vapor cools and turns back into liquid droplets.

quiz.say: If the sun shines brightly, the snowman will:
quiz.why: Bright sun means more warmth energy hitting the snow.

wrong.1: The warmth from the sun will always cause some melting.
wrong.2: Nothing makes the snowman grow bigger by melting.
wrong.3: It first turns into liquid water before it could turn into gas.
